purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove Villaeffekten eligibility, amount, budget availability or payment.

mappings.product_miss: The existing villa-energy benchmark already expected an energy-efficiency-grant route, and issue #11 explicitly identified Villaeffekten, but the common truth layer had no normalized current 2026 support record. Without a current-source regression the product could also collapse old-house intent into eligibility, confuse existing district-heating exclusion with a planned new district-heating connection, or present 30 percent as applying to the whole contractor invoice.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep one housing/energy truth layer and one scenario system. Add a review-gated Villaeffekten record grounded in Boverket plus current SFS, ask only route-changing property/measure/timing facts, distinguish existing district-heating status from a new connection measure, separate material from labour cost, preserve the transition deadline and county-board decision boundary, and never guarantee eligibility or amount.
